title: Card
description: Cardmarket prices of one card. Type part of its name in Search, then pick it in Card.

query.rawSql: SELECT arrow_cast(CASE '${game}' WHEN '1' THEN 'Magic' WHEN '21' THEN 'StarWarsUnlimited' END, 'Utf8') AS site
query.query: SELECT arrow_cast(CASE '${game}' WHEN '1' THEN 'Magic' WHEN '21' THEN 'StarWarsUnlimited' END, 'Utf8') AS site

query.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (product) product, name, category, id_expansion, date_added
  FROM product WHERE game = '${game}'
  ORDER BY product, time DESC
), hits AS (
  SELECT product, name, id_expansion, date_added,
    count(*) OVER (PARTITION BY id_expansion, name) AS versions,
    row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY id_expansion, name ORDER BY CAST(product AS BIGINT)) AS version
  FROM latest
  WHERE name ILIKE concat('%', ${search:sqlstring}, '%')
), labels AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (id_expansion) id_expansion, label FROM (
    SELECT id_expansion,
      CASE
        WHEN name ~* ':? Full Set( \(.*\))?$' THEN 1
        WHEN name ~* ':? (Rare|Common|Uncommon|Leader|Legendary|Base) Set$' THEN 2
        WHEN name ~ ': ""' THEN 3
        ELSE 4 END AS rank,
      trim(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(name,
        ':? (Full|Rare|Common|Uncommon|Leader|Legendary|Base) Set( \(.*\))?$', '', 'i'),
        ': "".*$', ''),
        '[: ]+(Foil Promo Pack|Promo Pack|Prerelease Promo|Buy-a-Box Promo|Booster Box|Booster Display|Booster|Display|Bundle|Prerelease Pack|Deck|Box)\b.*$', '', 'i')) AS label
    FROM latest
    WHERE category NOT LIKE '%Single' AND id_expansion IN (SELECT id_expansion FROM hits)
  ) WHERE label <> ''
  ORDER BY id_expansion, rank, length(label)
)
SELECT arrow_cast(concat(h.name, ' · ', coalesce(l.label, concat('Expansion ', h.id_expansion)),
         CASE WHEN h.versions > 1 THEN concat(' · V.', h.version) ELSE '' END,
         ' · ', h.product), 'Utf8') AS card
FROM hits h LEFT JOIN labels l ON l.id_expansion = h.id_expansion
ORDER BY h.date_added DESC, h.version LIMIT 200

options.content: Open on Cardmarket

targets.rawSql:
SELECT nullif(low, 0) AS low, nullif(trend, 0) AS trend, nullif(avg30, 0) AS avg30, nullif(low_foil, 0) AS low_foil, nullif(trend_foil, 0) AS trend_foil
FROM price
WHERE game = '${game}' AND product = '${card}'
ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT date_bin_gapfill(INTERVAL '1 day', time) AS time,
  locf(last_value(nullif(low, 0) ORDER BY time)) AS low,
  locf(last_value(nullif(trend, 0) ORDER BY time)) AS trend,
  locf(last_value(nullif(avg30, 0) ORDER BY time)) AS avg30,
  locf(last_value(nullif(low_foil, 0) ORDER BY time)) AS low_foil,
  locf(last_value(nullif(trend_foil, 0) ORDER BY time)) AS trend_foil
FROM price
WHERE game = '${game}' AND product = '${card}' AND $__timeFilter(time)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
